cases.name: fear-itself
cases.promptMarkdown: Identify the author of the quote in quote.txt

graders.name: correct-output
graders.graderMarkdown:
Check that information.md meets ALL of the following criteria:

1. Contains a **Quote** section with the original quote text ("The only thing we have to fear is fear itself.")
2. Contains an **Author** section that correctly identifies Franklin D. Roosevelt (accept "Franklin Roosevelt", "Franklin D. Roosevelt", "FDR")
3. Contains a **Source** section that correctly identifies this as from his first inaugural address (1933). Accept reasonable variants like "inaugural address", "first inaugural address", "1933 inaugural address".
4. Does NOT contain fabricated or incorrect information about the author or source
5. All three sections (Quote, Author, Source) are present
